bifrost: bifrost_app::defaults, coding, file_coordination, fswatch, workspace, quicksearch, document; docbroker file grants
summary: Settings, JSON and plist coding, file coordination, change events and Spotlight-style indexing have SDK APIs. There is no FileManager-style API, no keyed archiver or binary plist, and no iCloud.

features.feature: File System (create, read, write, examine files)
features.apple: FileManager, FileHandle, URL file APIs, FileWrapper, bookmarks
features.note: Apps use Rust std fs in their data dir; user files go through the file portal grants and document grants. No FileManager-like SDK type, no FileWrapper.
Advisory flock; no relinquish or move negotiation, no versions.
Recursive inotify stream with latency and a SHALLOW flag.
Recycle uses the shared Recently Deleted folder with Put Back.

features.feature: Archives and Serialization: JSON and property lists
features.note: JSON and XML plist only; no binary plist, Data unsupported, few strategies.
Codable-style traits exist; no keyed archive format.
Typed get/set and register(defaults:); no change-observation across processes noted.
One restorable window per app, JSON file.
Per-app JSON index, capped at 1000 items.
Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No file-system-wide metadata query API for apps.

Wave 3 (theme-01, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Apple iCloud service; BifrOSt Cloud backups/sync are separate and not an SDK file API.
Memory caches purge on pressure; no on-disk purgeable or backup exclusion flags.

gaps: FileManager-style SDK API (copy, move, attributes, enumerators)
iCloud / cloud-synced documents and key-value store
Backup exclusion and on-disk purgeable data
